play.definition: A sideline-breaking pass concept in which the primary receiver releases vertically, gains a defined route depth, decelerates at the top of the route, and plants before breaking sharply toward the nearest sideline. After the break, the receiver flattens the route horizontally or slightly downhill, turns toward the quarterback, and presents an outside target timed with the quarterback's throw.

Action_None.label: None
Action_None.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

Action_PassBlock.label: Pass Block
Action_PassBlock.definition: An offensive lineman or other offensive player's action to protect the quarterback from defensive rushers, establishing a pocket and preventing sacks or pressure.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

Action_RunOutRoute.label: Run Out Route
Action_RunOutRoute.definition: A receiver's route action consisting of a vertical stem followed by a sharp break toward the sideline.

Action_SnapReceive.label: Snap Receive
Action_SnapReceive.definition: The action of the quarterback securing the ball from the center’s snap to initiate the play.
